title: Combat Wild Shape
html:
This article is about the upgraded version of Wild Shape available to Circle of the Moon druids. For the base druid ability, see Wild Shape.
Combat Wild Shape is a Circle of the Moon druid bonus action that allows them to Wild Shape. They gain access to all base druid wild shape forms as well as their own exclusive forms.

Description

As a bonus action, you can assume the form of a beast. You can transform twice per Short Rest.

This ability otherwise acts as  Wild Shape.

Properties

Cost
 Bonus Action +  Wild Shape Charge
Details
 Range: Self

At higher levels

  • At 2nd level, grants access to exclusive wild shape form  Wild Shape: Bear.
  • At 4th level, grants access to exclusive wild shape form  Wild Shape: Dire Raven.
  • At 8th level, grants access to exclusive wild shape form  Wild Shape: Sabre-Toothed Tiger.
  • At 10th level, grants access to the exclusive wild shape forms  Wild Shape: Air Myrmidon,  Wild Shape: Earth Myrmidon,  Wild Shape: Fire Myrmidon, and  Wild Shape: Water Myrmidon.

Notes

  • Myrmidon forms consume  2 Wild Shape Charges as opposed to the normal 1.
  • Many items, feats, and class features do not work while in wild shape. See List of features that work in Wild Shape for an extensive list of what does and does not work.
